opening.argument: The video promises a free $500 Victoria's Secret gift card and repeatedly tells viewers to click the link in the description to obtain it. That description directs the promised benefit to a shortened external URL, while the available material shows no eligibility conditions or legitimate redemption process. The pitch therefore rests on an easy reward and a click-through instruction, not observable terms for receiving the card. The destination itself is not shown, so the evidence does not establish whether it requests data or payment, or what consequence follows from visiting it.
